sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti-Tarnish Blue Ombre Textured Enamel Kada
sourceNotes.rawContent: Dive into luxury with this premium blue ombre textured enamel kada. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure your jewelry remains as vibrant as the day you bought it. This chic, multi-tonal statement piece offers a sophisticated, modern aesthetic that maintains its brilliant luster through everyday wear.
